audit_items.proof_trace: `reserve.repay_amount` decreases `reserve.debt` by exactly `float::from(coin.value())` in the normal path (L213). `handle_repay` computes the refund residual via `obligation.repay_debt` and splits it before calling `reserve.repay_amount` (L469-486), so `coin.value()` equals the actual debt cleared. The only epsilon-deviation (≤1 base unit) arises when `ceil(obligation.debt)` fractionally exceeds `reserve.debt` in the over-repay branch (L206-211), which is intentional rounding—documented in code comments as a donation to the reserve.
